explanation: The theorem says that x ↦ ‖x‖^(a-1) is integrable, with respect to an additive Haar measure, on the punctured closed unit ball of the adic completion K_v, for every a > 0. I found no Mathlib result about integrability against Haar measure on nonarchimedean local fields or adic completions. Mathlib/MeasureTheory never mentions `adicCompletion` or `IsUltrametricDist`. Mathlib/NumberTheory/NumberField has no `Integrable` lemmas. The only rpow integrability lemmas in NumberTheory are in the L-series files, which deal with real integrals. The library's proof is a real argument: it splits the ball into dyadic-style shells, bounds the measure of each shell by a power of ‖π‖ times the measure of the unit ball, and sums a geometric series. A short derivation from one Mathlib lemma is therefore not available.
